items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was, I remember, live. We did that live.

ctx.x: One of the great undersung musicians of our time, I think.

This is when he was very young. He is a great musician. That was, I remember, live. We did that live. The first night was completely out. Second night was perfect. I came off the plane first night. I was out of tune. I was screwed up. We had a long conference the next day. I said, do a couple of changes, couple of this, couple of that, and that record is a very nice record. I haven’t heard it in years, but his writing – he’s a heavy cat.
Yeah. He sends me all his stuff.
